content: TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY HR Parental Leave Policy DOCUMENT ID HR-001 VERSION 4.2 POLICY OWNER People & Culture CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-01-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-01-01 Deﬁnes paid parental leave entitlements for primary and secondary caregivers, including the phased-return beneﬁt. 1. Purpose & Scope This policy applies to all regular full-time and part-time employees of TechTrapture who have completed at least 90 days of continuous service. It covers leave taken for the birth, adoption, or legal guardianship placement of a child. Contractors, interns, and temporary agency staﬀ are not eligible under this policy. 2. Primary Caregiver Leave — the "Cradle Clause" Eligible employees designated as the primary caregiver receive 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave at 100% of base salary. This entitlement is known internally as the Cradle Clause. Primary caregiver leave must commence within 12 months of the qualifying event and may be taken in a

of base salary. This entitlement is known internally as the Cradle Clause. Primary caregiver leave must commence within 12 months of the qualifying event and may be taken in a single continuous block or split into a maximum of two blocks with manager approval. 3. Secondary Caregiver Leave Employees designated as the secondary caregiver receive 8 weeks of fully paid leave at 100% of base salary, to be taken within 6 months of the qualifying event. Only one designation (primary or secondary) may be claimed per employee per qualifying event. Two TechTrapture employees sharing the same qualifying event must each declare a distinct role. 4. Phased Return Beneﬁt Following primary caregiver leave, employees may elect a 4-week phased return during which they work 60% of standard hours while receiving 100% of base pay. This beneﬁt is opt-in and must be requested at least 2 weeks before the leave end date.

which they work 60% of standard hours while receiving 100% of base pay. This beneﬁt is opt-in and must be requested at least 2 weeks before the leave end date. 5. Job Protection & Beneﬁts Continuity An employee's role, level, and reporting line are protected for the full duration of approved parental leave. Health, dental, and retirement contributions continue uninterrupted. Stock vesting continues on schedule for the ﬁrst 16 weeks of leave; vesting beyond 16 weeks is paused and resumes on return. 6. Requesting Leave Submit the Parental Leave Request in the TechTrapture People Portal at least 30 days before the intended start date where foreseeable. Adoption and emergency guardianship placements may be requested with shorter notice. Questions should be directed to people-leave@techtrapture.com. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. HR-001 v4.2 · Eﬀective 2026-01-01

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY HR Sick Leave & PTO Policy DOCUMENT ID HR-002 VERSION 6.0 POLICY OWNER People & Culture CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-01-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-01-01 Covers annual paid sick leave, paid time oﬀ (PTO) accrual, carryover, and the separation between the two. 1. Paid Sick Leave All regular employees are entitled to 12 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick days accrue at a rate of 1 day per completed month of service and are available for use as accrued. Sick leave is separate from and additional to PTO. It may be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or to care for an immediate family member. 2. Sick Leave Carryover Up to 5 unused sick days may be carried over into the following calendar year. Any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31 and is not paid out. Sick leave has no cash

days may be carried over into the following calendar year. Any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31 and is not paid out. Sick leave has no cash value and is never paid out on termination of employment. 3. Paid Time Oﬀ (PTO) Regular full-time employees accrue 22 days of PTO per year. Accrual is monthly and pro-rated for part-time employees based on scheduled hours. PTO covers vacation and personal days. It is distinct from public holidays, of which TechTrapture observes 11 per year. 4. PTO Carryover & Payout Up to 10 unused PTO days may roll into the next year. On termination, accrued and unused PTO is paid out at the ﬁnal base rate, subject to local law. Negative PTO balances (advanced and unworked) are recovered from ﬁnal pay. 5. Notice & Approval PTO of 3 days or more requires manager approval submitted at least 10 business

law. Negative PTO balances (advanced and unworked) are recovered from ﬁnal pay. 5. Notice & Approval PTO of 3 days or more requires manager approval submitted at least 10 business days in advance. Sick leave requires notiﬁcation to the manager by the start of the workday where possible. Absences of more than 3 consecutive sick days may require a medical certiﬁcate. TechTrapture — Internal. TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY HR Hybrid & Remote Work Policy DOCUMENT ID HR-003 VERSION 3.1 POLICY OWNER People & Culture CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-02-15 NEXT REVIEW 2027-02-15 Sets the minimum in-oﬃce expectation, remote eligibility, and the home-oﬃce stipend. 1. Default Working Model TechTrapture operates a hybrid-ﬁrst model. Oﬃce-assigned employees are expected on-site a minimum of 3 days per week, with Tuesday and Thursday designated as company-wide anchor days. Teams may set a fourth required day with director approval where collaboration needs justify it. 2. Fully Remote Roles A limited set of roles are approved as fully remote and are exempt from the 3-day expectation. Fully remote status is approved at the VP level and recorded in the People Portal. Fully remote employees must be reachable during the core collaboration window of 10:00–15:00 in their assigned team time zone. 3. Home Oﬃce Stipend Eligible remote and hybrid employees

People Portal. Fully remote employees must be reachable during the core collaboration window of 10:00–15:00 in their assigned team time zone. 3. Home Oﬃce Stipend Eligible remote and hybrid employees receive a one-time home-oﬃce setup stipend of $600 and an annual refresh allowance of $200, claimed through the Expense Portal. The stipend covers desk, chair, monitor, and peripherals. It does not cover internet service, which is reimbursed separately at $40 per month for fully remote employees only. 4. Working From a Diﬀerent Location Employees may work from a location other than their registered home or oﬃce for up to 20 working days per year domestically without prior approval, provided security requirements are met. International remote work requires People and Tax review and is capped at 30 days per year. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. HR-003 v3.1 · Eﬀective 2026-02-15

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY HR Code of Conduct & Anti-Harassment Policy DOCUMENT ID HR-004 VERSION 5.3 POLICY OWNER Legal & People CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-01-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-01-01 States expected standards of behavior, prohibited conduct, and the reporting and investigation process. 1. Our Standards Every TechTrapture employee is expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues and customers with respect, and uphold the values set out in the TechTrapture Operating Principles. This policy applies in all work settings, including oﬃces, remote work, business travel, company events, and work-related digital channels. 2. Prohibited Conduct Harassment, discrimination, bullying, and retaliation are strictly prohibited. This includes conduct based on race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Sexual harassment — including unwelcome advances, comments, or display of explicit material — is a serious violation that may result in immediate termination. 3. Reporting Concerns Concerns may

protected characteristic. Sexual harassment — including unwelcome advances, comments, or display of explicit material — is a serious violation that may result in immediate termination. 3. Reporting Concerns Concerns may be raised with any manager, with People & Culture, or anonymously through the TechTrapture SpeakUp line at speakup.techtrapture.com, available 24/7. All reports are handled conﬁdentially. TechTrapture prohibits retaliation against anyone who reports a concern in good faith or participates in an investigation. 4. Investigation & Outcomes Reports are acknowledged within 2 business days and investigations are targeted for completion within 30 days. Outcomes range from coaching and formal warnings to termination, depending on severity. Knowingly false reports made in bad faith are themselves a violation of this policy. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. HR-004 v5.3 · Eﬀective 2026-01-01

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY FINANCE Expense Reimbursement Policy DOCUMENT ID FIN-001 VERSION 7.1 POLICY OWNER Finance Operations CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-03-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-03-01 Deﬁnes reimbursable business expenses, receipt thresholds, daily meal caps, and submission deadlines. 1. General Principle TechTrapture reimburses reasonable, necessary, and properly documented business expenses. Expenses must be incurred wholly for legitimate business purposes and comply with this policy. When in doubt, employees should seek pre-approval from their manager before incurring an expense. 2. Receipts & Documentation An itemized receipt is required for every expense over $25. Expenses of $25 or less may be claimed without a receipt but must include a brief business justiﬁcation. Each claim must record the business purpose, attendees (for meals), and the project or cost center. 3. Meal Limits Reimbursable meals while traveling are capped at $60 per day for domestic travel and $90 per day for international travel.

meals), and the project or cost center. 3. Meal Limits Reimbursable meals while traveling are capped at $60 per day for domestic travel and $90 per day for international travel. Alcohol is reimbursable only for approved client-entertainment events and must be itemized separately. Team meals not associated with travel require manager pre-approval and are capped at $40 per head. 4. Submission Deadline Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Claims submitted more than 60 days after the expense date will not be reimbursed except in documented exceptional circumstances approved by Finance. Reimbursements are paid in the next scheduled payroll cycle after approval. 5. Non-Reimbursable Items Personal entertainment, traﬃc ﬁnes, airline change fees due to personal preference, hotel mini-bar charges, and loyalty-program fees are not reimbursable. See the Travel & Per Diem Policy for airfare class rules and per diem rates. TechTrapture — Internal. Do

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY FINANCE Travel & Per Diem Policy DOCUMENT ID FIN-002 VERSION 8.0 POLICY OWNER Finance Operations CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-03-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-03-01 Sets airfare class rules (the Skyline Rule), per diem rates, hotel caps, and booking requirements. 1. Booking & Approval All business travel must be booked through the TechTrapture Travel Hub (managed by our travel partner) and approved by the employee's manager before tickets are issued. Travel should be booked at least 14 days in advance where possible to access lower fares. 2. Airfare Class — the "Skyline Rule" Economy class is the default for all ﬂights. Premium economy may be booked for any single ﬂight segment with scheduled duration over 6 hours. Business class is permitted only when a single ﬂight segment exceeds 8 hours of scheduled ﬂight time, or for international itineraries with a total one-way distance over 3,500 miles.

hours. Business class is permitted only when a single ﬂight segment exceeds 8 hours of scheduled ﬂight time, or for international itineraries with a total one-way distance over 3,500 miles. This threshold is known as the Skyline Rule. First class is never reimbursable. Employees who wish to upgrade beyond their eligible class may do so at personal expense; TechTrapture reimburses only the eligible fare. 3. Per Diem Rates In lieu of itemized meal receipts, employees may claim a per diem of $75 per day for domestic travel and $110 per day for international travel. Designated high-cost cities (New York, London, Tokyo, San Francisco, Singapore) carry a $140 per day rate. Per diem and itemized meal reimbursement cannot both be claimed for the same trip. 4. Lodging Hotel room rates are capped at $250 per night domestically and $320 per night internationally, excluding taxes. Stays above the cap require director pre-approval.

Employees are encouraged to use TechTrapture-preferred hotels, which bill directly to the corporate account. 5. Ground Transport Standard ride-share, economy rental cars, and public transit are reimbursable. Premium and luxury vehicle classes are not reimbursable without a documented business reason. TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY FINANCE Corporate Card Usage Policy DOCUMENT ID FIN-003 VERSION 2.4 POLICY OWNER Finance Operations CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-03-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-03-01 Governs eligibility, default spending limits, reconciliation deadlines, and misuse consequences for the TechTrapture corporate card. 1. Eligibility & Issuance Corporate cards are issued to employees whose roles require regular business spending, on manager and Finance approval. The card remains the property of TechTrapture and must be returned on request or on termination. Cards are issued through the TechTrapture Card Portal and activated by the cardholder. 2. Default Spending Limit The default monthly spending limit is $5,000 per cardholder. Higher limits may be granted up to $15,000 with director approval, or above $15,000 with VP Finance approval. Single-transaction limits default to $2,500; transactions above this require pre-authorization in the Card Portal. 3. Reconciliation Cardholders must reconcile and code all transactions in the Expense

with VP Finance approval. Single-transaction limits default to $2,500; transactions above this require pre-authorization in the Card Portal. 3. Reconciliation Cardholders must reconcile and code all transactions in the Expense Portal within 10 business days of the statement close date. Itemized receipts follow the Expense Reimbursement Policy thresholds. Unreconciled balances older than 30 days may result in temporary card suspension. 4. Prohibited Use & Misuse The corporate card must never be used for personal purchases, cash advances, or to circumvent the Travel & Per Diem Policy. Personal use, even if later repaid, is a policy violation. Repeated or deliberate misuse may result in card revocation, recovery of funds from payroll, and disciplinary action up to termination. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. FIN-003 v2.4 · Eﬀective 2026-03-01

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY IT Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Policy DOCUMENT ID IT-001 VERSION 3.0 POLICY OWNER Information Security CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-04-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-04-01 Deﬁnes whether and how personal devices, including personal laptops, may access company data. 1. Scope This policy governs the use of employee-owned (personal) devices — laptops, phones, and tablets — to access TechTrapture systems and data. It works alongside the Data Classiﬁcation Policy. TechTrapture-issued managed devices are governed by the Acceptable Use Policy, not this policy. 2. Personal Laptops Personal laptops may not be used to access, store, or process data classiﬁed as Conﬁdential or Restricted under any circumstances. Personal laptops may access only Public and Internal data, and only after enrollment in the TechTrapture MobileGuard MDM proﬁle and connection through the company VPN. Where an employee's role routinely requires Conﬁdential or Restricted data, TechTrapture issues a managed laptop and

after enrollment in the TechTrapture MobileGuard MDM proﬁle and connection through the company VPN. Where an employee's role routinely requires Conﬁdential or Restricted data, TechTrapture issues a managed laptop and personal-laptop access is not permitted for that work. Contact IT to request a managed device. 3. Personal Phones & Tablets Personal phones and tablets may access company email, calendar, and chat after enrolling in MobileGuard. Enrollment enforces a device passcode, disk encryption, and the ability to remotely wipe TechTrapture data only (selective wipe). Jailbroken or rooted devices are prohibited from accessing any TechTrapture data. 4. Security Requirements All BYOD devices must run a supported, patched operating system, have full-disk encryption enabled, and use the company VPN for access to internal systems. MobileGuard continuously veriﬁes these conditions. A device that falls out of compliance is automatically blocked until remediated. 5. Loss, Theft & Oﬀboarding Lost or stolen BYOD devices must be

systems. MobileGuard continuously veriﬁes these conditions. A device that falls out of compliance is automatically blocked until remediated. 5. Loss, Theft & Oﬀboarding Lost or stolen BYOD devices must be reported to security@techtrapture.com within 24 hours so a selective wipe can be issued. On oﬀboarding, all TechTrapture data and the MobileGuard proﬁle are removed from personal devices; personal data is unaﬀected. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. IT-001 v3.0 · Eﬀective 2026-04-01

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY IT Data Classiﬁcation & Acceptable Use Policy DOCUMENT ID IT-002 VERSION 4.1 POLICY OWNER Information Security CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-04-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-04-01 Deﬁnes TechTrapture's four data classiﬁcation tiers and the acceptable-use rules for company systems. 1. Classiﬁcation Tiers TechTrapture classiﬁes all information into four tiers: Public, Internal, Conﬁdential, and Restricted. Every document, dataset, and system must carry a classiﬁcation; unclassiﬁed data is treated as Internal by default. Public: approved for external release. Internal: for all employees but not external parties. Conﬁdential: limited to speciﬁc teams or need-to-know. Restricted: highly sensitive (e.g., customer PII, security keys, unreleased ﬁnancials), access logged and tightly controlled. 2. Handling Requirements Restricted data must be encrypted at rest and in transit, accessed only from managed devices, and never sent to personal email or unapproved cloud services. Conﬁdential data follows the same rules except where an approved exception is

and in transit, accessed only from managed devices, and never sent to personal email or unapproved cloud services. Conﬁdential data follows the same rules except where an approved exception is documented. Internal and Public data may be handled on MobileGuard-enrolled personal devices per the BYOD Policy. 3. Acceptable Use of Systems TechTrapture systems are provided for business use. Limited personal use is permitted provided it does not interfere with work, consume signiﬁcant resources, or violate any policy. Prohibited activities include accessing data without authorization, installing unapproved software on managed devices, disabling security controls, and using TechTrapture systems for illegal activity or harassment. 4. Approved AI & Cloud Tools Only AI assistants and cloud services on the TechTrapture Approved Tools list may process TechTrapture data. Conﬁdential and Restricted data must never be pasted into a public AI tool. Requests to add a tool to the approved list are submitted through the

may process TechTrapture data. Conﬁdential and Restricted data must never be pasted into a public AI tool. Requests to add a tool to the approved list are submitted through the IT Service Desk. 5. Monitoring TechTrapture may monitor and audit use of its systems for security and compliance. Employees should have no expectation of privacy in data stored on or transmitted through TechTrapture systems. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. IT-002 v4.1 · Eﬀective 2026-04-01

TechTrapture EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK · POLICY LIBRARY OPERATIONS Learning & Development Reimbursement Policy DOCUMENT ID OPS-001 VERSION 3.2 POLICY OWNER People & Culture CLASSIFICATION Internal EFFECTIVE DATE 2026-01-01 NEXT REVIEW 2027-01-01 Deﬁnes the annual professional-development allowance (GrowthFund), certiﬁcation and conference sub- limits, and the service commitment. 1. The GrowthFund Allowance Each eligible employee may claim up to $2,500 per calendar year toward approved professional development. This annual allowance is known as the GrowthFund. The allowance covers courses, online subscriptions, professional certiﬁcations, books, and conference attendance, subject to the sub-limits below. Unused GrowthFund does not roll over. 2. Sub-Limits Within the $2,500 annual cap: professional certiﬁcations (exam and prep) are reimbursed up to $1,200, and conference registration is reimbursed up to $1,500. Travel and lodging for conferences follow the Travel & Per Diem Policy and are funded separately from the GrowthFund. A single course or program above $1,500 requires manager pre-approval before

Travel and lodging for conferences follow the Travel & Per Diem Policy and are funded separately from the GrowthFund. A single course or program above $1,500 requires manager pre-approval before enrollment. 3. Eligibility & Approval Employees become eligible after 90 days of service. All requests must be approved by the employee's manager and demonstrate relevance to the employee's current role or a planned internal growth path. Reimbursement is paid on successful completion; for certiﬁcations, a passing result is required. 4. Service Commitment For any single reimbursement above $1,000, the employee agrees to remain with TechTrapture for 12 months after completion. If the employee voluntarily leaves before 12 months, a pro-rated portion of the reimbursement is recovered from ﬁnal pay. This commitment does not apply to reimbursements of $1,000 or less. TechTrapture — Internal. Do not distribute externally. OPS-001 v3.2 · Eﬀective 2026-01-01
